method: mapgrid.swift tiles (7 tiles of ~260x190 source px enlarged to 1200 px wide with a 20 px grid, plus 5 close-up tiles with a 10 px grid for Arras, the SST symbols, Montreuil, the '5' and Savy); coordinates read off the grid in original-image pixels. Read from the image only. The scan is greyscale, so the legend's RED (British) / GREEN (French) cannot be told apart: no French unit label is printed, and the counter-attack tracks are arrows (not features). A '7'-shaped mark at about [684,305] by Ecurie was read as an arrowhead with shaft, not a unit numeral, and is not listed. Legend symbols at the bottom are not listed.
